title: Egg Speckle
description: The speckled surface of a wild bird's egg — and the spray-marbled flecking on old notebook covers it inspired. A tinted shell is continually misted with pigment: fine specks, soft airbrush blooms, larger blotches and the odd ink squiggle, accumulating on a buffer that slowly renews so the pattern keeps breathing. Clutch presets range from real eggs (robin, quail, guillemot, dunnock) to a multi-colour notebook spray; density, fineness, blotches, squiggles, mist and renewal are live. Beats fling a burst of speckles; tap to puff pigment where you point.
